BETA Close X Associated British Foods plc has announced the repurchase of 29,584 of its ordinary shares on 23 July 2026, at an average price of GBp 1972.3102 per share, with the highest price paid being GBp 1979.5000 and the lowest GBp 1966.0000. These shares were purchased from Barclays Capital Securities Limited as part of the company's ongoing share repurchase program and are intended for cancellation. The total value of this transaction amounts to approximately £583,100.
